en.topic_title: Hong Kong political leaders and grandees pay tribute to ‘visionary’ leader Tung Chee-hwa
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong leader John Lee has joined a chorus of senior politicians and local grandees paying tribute to Tung Chee-hwa, the city’s first leader after its 1997 handover to China.



Tung Chee-hwa signing a bill as the chief executive in 1997. File Photo: GovHK.
